summary: Google DeepMind reports results of a randomized controlled trial measuring the impact of Gemini's Guided Learning feature on math learning outcomes for junior secondary students in Sierra Leone, and releases an RCT playbook and teacher training guide.

practices.reason: The lab describes and releases a pre-registered RCT methodology and playbook for measuring AI's educational impact that other teams could adapt to run their own scaled evaluations.
practices.quote: are also releasing a playbook on our approach to RCTs with Fab AI to help others run faster, scalable studies aligned to their needs and contexts — to uncover robust localised evidence that keeps pace with technological advances.
